newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM suspends expansion of European fleet.
newsitem.headline: KLM suspends expansion of European fleet.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Tuesday it was suspending expansion of its European fleet as part of a cost-cutting drive to improve profitability.
KLM Chairman Pieter Bouw said KLM would have to reduce the costs of its own fleet and crew substantially.

"If we cannot succeed in reducing these costs sufficiently, then we shall be obliged to make increasing use of partners and operators who are capable of providing the quality we want at the cost level we require," Bouw told reporters.
"In this context we have decided to suspend any further expansion of the European fleet within KLM," he said.
Bouw said KLM would also reconsider several outstanding aircraft orders for its intercontinental fleet.
